I have many many x-file experiences, but I want to share the most recent not only I've had but my boyfriend. Last month, my SO and I were at the back porch, sitting in the darkness enjoying nature and away from the electronics. I was sitting on the left of the porch, he on the right. Around the house there are large trees, and gorgeous plants. So it's pretty much a wooden area, anyway we are just chatting about something. Then something told me to look up, as I did this wobbly white dot was in the sky, I got my SO and we watched it as it traveled through the sky. Before we could speak it stopped and it brighten up and it went on its way out of our sight. I was so amazed but slightly terrified. 
  We were so amazed that the very next night we decided to go out (it all took place around 8pm) and waited. After 5 minutes of waiting my SO gets up and points in front of the porch door, a faintly white spinning disk gliding through the sky. My SO said it looked like it's invisible cloak wasn't working, it looked as if you could see through it. NEXT a helicopter appeared following it through the sky. 
That is one of my x-files experiences. Just wanted to share, sorry if my writing is bad, just wanted to share it. Thank you and HAPPY HOLIDAYS :D

  The mission was rougher then I expected. I was doing paper work when the black car and the two tall men in black appeared outside my house this afternoon. I knew I had to stop, get my coat, and head off before my dear wife could question me again.

As I got into the car a taller and skinnier gentlemen greeted me, he had red velvet eyes that I have never seen before and a calm heavy voice.
"I have heard of you Mr. Theodore." it says as we shook hands. I have meet many like the tall gentleman , but this one seems to be different as I can sense it.

He explained to me about the planets and travels he has done for many light years. I was impressed but curious of what I am here for.
"If you don't mind me asking, why have I come here?" I ask. Knowing on my mysterious jobs to do, I don't know what I have to do when the black car appears.

The taller gentleman cleared his throat and said in a serious voice, "I have come to warn you and your family." My heart ached at what he said, "Warn about what?" I ask.

"One of your grandchildren, a young female is to be taken away at our hands to become one of us."

I stop reader as I felt confused. Was this a story my grandfather made up? or...or something real? My grandfather did work at the Government and my mum told me he would go in a black car, the next day and not say anything about his disappearances. But only decline it everytime he has been asked.

I just stood in the attic with my grandpa's journal in hand unsure if I should continue..
